password.title: Sign in
password.label: Password or token
password.hint: Many hosts, including GitHub, need a personal access token here instead of your account password.

ssh_passphrase.title: Unlock SSH key
ssh_passphrase.label: Passphrase
ssh_passphrase.note: ssh asks for the passphrase every time unless the key is added to an SSH agent.

host_key.title: Trust this server?
host_key.label: Fingerprint
host_key.body: This is the first connection to {{target}}. Check that this fingerprint matches the one the host publishes before you continue.

saved: If Git is set up with a credential helper, it remembers what you enter.
retry: The passphrase or password you entered is incorrect. Try again.

remember.label: Remember on this computer
remember.hint: Kept in the system keychain once the sign-in works. Remove it any time in Settings › Accounts.
